_metadata.source: Jeppesen Airway Manual - Chart Change Notices (CCN) & NavData Change Notices (NCN)
_metadata.cycle: Cycle 2610 (01 Oct - 28 Oct 2026) & Cycle 2611 (29 Oct - 25 Nov 2026)

SBJH.name: São Paulo Catarina Executive Intl
SBJH.dclAftn: SBJHYDYX (VHF Clearance Delivery 121.650 MHz / DCL via ACARS)

ccnNotices.title: São Paulo TMA (SBCW) — International Executive Customs & Slot Coordination
ccnNotices.detail: International departures from SBJH require prior PF/RFB customs activation and CGNA slot adherence within ±15 mins of EOBT.

ncnNotices.title: RNP Y RWY 12 & ILS Z RWY 12 — Verify Transition Altitude 8000 ft
ncnNotices.detail: Ensure FMS Transition Altitude is set to 8000 ft in São Paulo TMA; verify RNAV 1 SID waypoint speed constraints below FL100.

SBJH.taxiRestrictions: Executive apron stands controlled by Marshaller; pushback mandatory on main executive apron.

SGAS.name: Silvio Pettirossi Intl (Asunción)
SGAS.dclAftn: SGASZPZX (Voice Clearance on Asunción Delivery / Approach 119.7 MHz)

ccnNotices.title: Jeppesen SAM CCN p.60: Paraguay AIC A004/24 — Minimum Takeoff Visibility 400m
ccnNotices.detail: Based on AIC A004/24, the minimum meteorological visibility required for takeoff at all Paraguayan airports (including SGAS & SGES) is 400m.

ccnNotices.title: Jeppesen SAM Directory p.1281: SGAS RFF Category 8 & Customs H24
ccnNotices.detail: RWY 02/20 (11,000 ft x 148 ft, Asphalt, PCN 54/F/C/W/U). HIRL, PAPI-L (3.0°), RVR not installed (MET VIS controlling).

ncnNotices.title: RWY 02/20 Non-Precision / ILS Degradation Cross-Check
ncnNotices.detail: When RWY 02 ALS or GS is downgraded by NOTAM, apply ICAO AWOM 3D/2D visibility penalties (750m / 1200m floor).

SGAS.taxiRestrictions: Caution on Apron 1 & TWY A intersections for wide-turn corporate jets; follow marshaller guidance.

SGES.name: Guaraní Intl (Ciudad del Este)

ccnNotices.title: Jeppesen SAM CCN p.60: AIC A004/24 — Minimum Takeoff Visibility 400m
ccnNotices.detail: Minimum meteorological visibility required for takeoff at all Paraguayan airports is 400m.

ncnNotices.title: Jeppesen SAM NCN p.86 & p.91: VES VOR/DME (114.1 MHz) Unserviceable — VOR Procs Suspended
ncnNotices.detail: Ciudad del Este VOR/DME VES 114.1 MHz is unserviceable. VOR RWY 05 and VOR RWY 23 approach procedures are suspended (though still present in FMS NavData). Use RNAV (GNSS) or ILS procedures only.

SGES.taxiRestrictions: Verify RFF Category (CAT 5 standard) if using SGES as an en-route/destination alternate.

SBFI.name: Foz do Iguaçu / Cataratas Intl

ccnNotices.title: Jeppesen SAM CCN p.48: SBFI Obstacle Lighting Unserviceable & Pushback Mandatory
ccnNotices.detail: Foz Do Iguacu, Brazil (Cataratas Intl): Obstacle lighting unserviceable at coordinates 253602.07S 0542900.28W, 253601.51S 0542859.35W, and 253512.00S 0542906.00W. Pushback procedure is mandatory across the entire apron area.

SBFI.taxiRestrictions: Pushback procedure is mandatory in the entire apron area (Jeppesen SAM CCN p.48).

ncnNotices.title: Jeppesen SAM NCN p.88: LON VOR (112.4 MHz) Unserviceable — 6 Approach Procedures Not Usable
ncnNotices.detail: Due to LON VOR (112.4 MHz) out of service, the following procedures in FMS NavData are NOT usable until Est 31 Dec 2026: VOR D, VOR Z Rwy 13, VOR Y Rwy 13, VOR Rwy 31, LOC Rwy 13, and ILS Y Rwy 13. Use RNP (GNSS) or ILS Z (with radar/GNSS) only.

SBMG.name: Maringá / Sílvio Name Júnior
SBMG.g650erWingspanStatus: COMPLIANT WITH CAUTION (TWY C restricted to max 36m wingspan — G650ER is 30.36m)

ccnNotices.title: Jeppesen SAM CCN p.51: TWY C Wingspan Restriction (<36m) & Continuous Visual Watch
ccnNotices.detail: TWY C restricted to aircraft with wingspan less than 36m (Code C). Continuous visual watch mandatory during taxiing on TWY C and Patio 1. Aircraft without steerable nosewheel must shut down prior to turn into parking position.

SBMG.taxiRestrictions: TWY C max wingspan <36m (G650ER is 30.36m — maintain strict centerline tracking and continuous visual watch on TWY C and Patio 1).

SAEZ.name: Buenos Aires / Ministro Pistarini (Ezeiza)

ccnNotices.title: Jeppesen SAM CCN p.42: AIP SUP A05/26 & A06/26 — RWY 11/29 & RWY 17/35 Rehabilitation
ccnNotices.detail: Based on AIP SUP A05/26 & A06/26, major pavement works affect RWY 11/29, RWY 17/35, and TWY F/G/D intersections. Verify active runway and displaced threshold NOTAMs prior to approach briefing.

SAEZ.taxiRestrictions: Follow temporary taxiway routing per AIP SUP A05/26 & A06/26.

KTEB.name: Teterboro Airport (New Jersey)
KTEB.dclAftn: KTEB (Pre-Departure Clearance via CPDLC DCL / ACARS PDC)
KTEB.g650erWingspanStatus: COMPLIANT WITH WEIGHT/NOISE BRIEFING (Max 100,000 lbs ramp waiver / G650ER weight mgmt required)

ccnNotices.title: Jeppesen General Bulletin p.37-39: US Lower-Than-Standard Takeoff Minimums (OpSpecs C078/C079)
ccnNotices.detail: Effective Sept 2026 revision: RVR 500 ft (unaided CL+HIRL) or RVR 300 ft (aided HUD/EFVS + CL + HIRL) authorized per OpSpecs C078/C079. Ensure EFVS derived visibility >= RVR 1600 ft.

ncnNotices.title: Teterboro RNAV (GPS) X RWY 06 / ILS RWY 06 — RUUDY / DANDY Altitude Cross-Check
ncnNotices.detail: Strict compliance with 2000 ft / 1500 ft stepdown altitudes required to maintain vertical separation below Newark (KEWR) arrival corridor.

KTEB.taxiRestrictions: 100,000 lb weight limit requires prior Port Authority / FBO authorization for G650ER operations; monitor wingtip clearance on TWY L and FBO ramps.

EGGW.name: London Luton Airport
EGGW.dclAftn: EGGWZTZX (ACARS DCL Logon: EGGW — 25 mins prior to EOBT)

ccnNotices.title: Jeppesen General Bulletin p.34-36: EASA Air Ops AOM — LVTO & 3D/2D Minimums
ccnNotices.detail: LVP required below RVR 550m; operator approval required below RVR 400m. CAT III without rollout guidance lowered from 200m to 175m.

ncnNotices.title: Jeppesen Europe NCN p.122: Luton NDB(L) 'LUT' Unavailable — Mandatory RNAV Substitution
ncnNotices.detail: NDB(L) LUT is unavailable UFN. For all Instrument Flight Procedures (IFPs) at EGGW, the position of LUT NDB MUST be defined in the FMS by I-LTN D4.7, I-LJ D3.9, or BKY VOR R242.9/D13 using RNAV substitution.

EGGW.taxiRestrictions: Signature / Harrods Business Aviation Apron: follow marshaller guidance; wingtip clearance restrictions on Delta Link.

LFPB.name: Paris Le Bourget
LFPB.dclAftn: LFPBZTZX (ACARS DCL Logon: LFPB — 30 to 5 mins prior to EOBT)

ccnNotices.title: Paris Le Bourget Noise Abatement & CDG (LFPG) Proximity Ceiling
ccnNotices.detail: Strict adherence to initial SID climb cap (3000 ft / 4000 ft) mandatory due to Charles de Gaulle (LFPG) overhead departure traffic.

ncnNotices.title: RNP RWY 27 / ILS RWY 27 — EGNOS/SBAS LPV Cross-Check
ncnNotices.detail: When RWY 07/25 is closed by NOTAM, verify active RWY 09/27 or 03/21 approach coding and LPV channel availability.

LFPB.taxiRestrictions: Avoid jet blast on FBO aprons (Advanced Air Support / Dassault / Signature).

LSGG.name: Geneva Cointrin Intl
LSGG.dclAftn: LSGGZTZX (ACARS DCL Logon: LSGG — 25 mins prior to EOBT)

ccnNotices.title: Geneva LVP & ATN B1 Data Link Mandate
ccnNotices.detail: Ensure ATN B1 (VDL Mode 2) is active prior to climb into LSAG upper airspace.

ncnNotices.title: Swiss NavData Notice (Europe p.121): Verify RNP AR / GLS Status
ncnNotices.detail: Note that at nearby LSGS (Sion) RNP RWY 25 (AR) is suspended UFN and at LSZH (Zurich) GLS RWY 14 is suspended due to GBAS outage. At LSGG, when ILS RWY 22 GS is out by NOTAM, brief LOC RWY 22 (2D/CDFA) minimums.

LSGG.taxiRestrictions: Terminal 3 (Business Aviation) parking requires prior PPR slot and tow-in/pushback.

HECA.name: Cairo International Airport

ccnNotices.title: Jeppesen Africa CCN p.14-16: Extensive Cairo FIR (HECC) ATS Route Redesignations
ccnNotices.detail: Routes A727, L81, L315, L604, M720, M872, P557, Q2, and T223 around Cairo VORDME (CVO) modified in Cycle 2610/2611. Cross-check filed FPL waypoints against FMS database.

ncnNotices.title: Jeppesen Africa NCN p.54: HECA GPS Jamming Within 10 NM — RNAV (GNSS) Prohibited
ncnNotices.detail: HECA, Cairo Intl: 'RNAV (GNSS) Apch Procs should not be planned due to GPS jamming within 10 NM from Cairo ARP, UFN.' Although RNAV (GNSS) approaches remain in the FMS database, crews MUST plan and fly ILS or conventional VOR approaches only.

HECA.taxiRestrictions: VIP / Executive Hall 4 apron requires follow-me vehicle guidance.

ncnNotices.title: Jeppesen Africa NCN p.53: EGNOS Signal Reduction — All LPV Approaches & LPC VOR Suspended
ncnNotices.detail: Based on SUP 128/26 & 156/26, due to reduced EGNOS (SBAS) signal availability, RNP RWY 03L/03R (LPV only) and RNP Z RWY 21L/21R (LPV only) are NOT USABLE. Furthermore, DVOR/DME LPC is unserviceable until 11 Jun 2027 (ILS X 03L, ILS Y 21R, VOR 03L/21R unusable).

LEMD.name: Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas

ncnNotices.title: Jeppesen Europe NCN p.118: Spain EGNOS/SBAS LPV Suspension — RNP Z (LPV Only) U/S
ncnNotices.detail: RNP Z RWY 18L (LPV only), RNP Z RWY 18R (LPV only), RNP Z RWY 32L (LPV only), and RNP Z RWY 32R (LPV only) Apch Procs are U/S (Est 03 Sep 2027). Additionally, ILS X RWY 18L/18R not to be used 13-28 Oct 2026 and DVOR/DME 'NVS' unavailable eff 29 Oct 2026.

LEMD.taxiRestrictions: Executive Aviation Apron (Terminal 4 / Torrejón alternate) requires marshaller.

OEJN.name: King Abdulaziz Intl (Jeddah)
OEJN.dclAftn: JEDDAYA (Saudi DCL AFTN Logon per AIP SUP 18/26 — Middle East p.22)

ccnNotices.title: Jeppesen Middle East CCN p.22: Saudi Arabia Departure Clearance (DCL) AFTN Logon Addresses
ccnNotices.detail: Based on AIP SUP 18/26, DCL is available prior to taxiing via AFTN LOGON: JEDDAH TOWER = JEDDAYA, RIYADH TOWER = RUHDAYA, MADINAH TOWER = MEDDAYA, DAMMAM TOWER = DMMCAYA, GASSIM TOWER = ELQBAYA, ABHA TOWER = AHBAAYA. Once taxiing, clearance revisions are via VHF voice only.

ncnNotices.title: Jeppesen Middle East NCN p.47: OEJN Stand 5 on Apron 6 Closed
ncnNotices.detail: Stand 5 on Apron 6 closed. Also note King Faisal Naval Base (OEJF) ILS RWY 33 U/S until 23 Dec 2026.

OEJN.taxiRestrictions: Once aircraft starts taxiing, ATC clearance revisions are via VHF voice only (DCL terminated at taxi).

KASE.name: Aspen-Pitkin County Airport (Sardy Field)
KASE.g650erWingspanStatus: RESTRICTED — 95.0 ft (28.96m) Max Wingspan Limit (G650ER is 99 ft 7 in / 30.36m — Prior Waiver or Diversion to KRIL/KEGE Required!)

ccnNotices.title: KASE Wingspan Restriction (95.0 ft / 28.96m) vs G650ER (99.6 ft / 30.36m)
ccnNotices.detail: Aspen (KASE) enforces a strict 95.0 ft (28.96m) wingspan limit due to Runway 15/33 – Taxiway A separation. Gulfstream G650ER wingspan is 99 ft 7 in (30.36m). Operations prohibited without specific airport director/FAA waiver; use Rifle (KRIL) or Eagle (KEGE).

ncnNotices.title: LOC/DME-E & RNAV (GPS)-F — Special Mountain Missed Approach Climb Gradient & Night Curfew
ncnNotices.detail: Verify high-altitude missed approach climb gradient performance (up to 440 ft/NM) and Visual Segment - Obstacles in Roaring Fork Valley.

KASE.taxiRestrictions: PROHIBITED for wingspans >95.0 ft (28.96m) on TWY A parallel to RWY 15/33 without closure/sterilization.

KVNY.name: Van Nuys Airport (Los Angeles)
KVNY.dclAftn: KVNY (CPDLC DCL / PDC Available via Clearance Delivery 126.6 MHz)

ccnNotices.title: KVNY RWY 16R Displaced Threshold & Burbank (KBUR) Proximity
ccnNotices.detail: Verify RWY 16R LDA (7,280 ft vs 8,001 ft TORA) and NOTAM crane obstacles on short final.

ncnNotices.title: ILS Y RWY 16R & RNAV (GPS) Y RWY 16R — Visual Segment & Raised DA/MDA
ncnNotices.detail: Cross-check active crane NOTAMs raising ILS RWY 16R DA to 1210 ft MSL and disabling ALS.

KVNY.taxiRestrictions: Avoid RWY 16L/34R (light GA training runway, 4,013 ft); use RWY 16R/34L and TWY A/B.
